scope: Reviewed complete common-header transfers only. These exceptions do not approve other accesses in the containing functions.
policy: Retain the four ordered word assignments: they transfer every common-header bit, including reserved bits and links. Do not replace them with property writes or assume overlapping records permit a whole-struct assignment.

transfers.reason: Transfer the complete common header to the replacement static slot before link and quality adjustments.
Copy all common-header bits to the save record before separately translating chain and equipment links.
Restore all common-header bits from the save record before separately translating live links.
Clone the source header before selecting the new object ID, quantity and placement.
Clone the complete stack header before setting the two resulting counts and inserting the new record.
Clone the complete selected-stack header before setting the resulting quantities and link placement.
Clone the template header before randomizing the spawned ID and position.
Transfer the common header into the allocated mobile slot before constructing its extension and relinking.
Store the complete cursor-held object header in the save record before serializing its contents.
Restore the complete cursor-held object header before restoring any contents links.
Clone the static template common header; the adjacent mobile-template branch separately copies the full mobile record.
Clone the linked record header before replacing the parent link and clearing the cloned next link.
Clone the linked record header before inserting the new record in the trap-owned chain.
